QuestInfo.name: [Labyrinth of Suffering] Confusion
QuestInfo.0: By the time you return to the #m450011120#, the soldier you left on guard is nowhere to be found. The only one left is the wounded soldier, gazing intently at you with a dark, mocking grin on his face.
